headline.description: At most 2 lines of at most 120 characters; numbers must match the items' evidence; no URLs.

item_id.description: An accepted item id from this run.

text.description: At most 2 lines of at most 120 characters; numbers must match evidence; no URLs.

bullets.description: One per body item named in the Body layout section of the prompt, in that order (checked by the gate). A programme's own line is written by code.

thread_order.description: Every accepted item id: the body items first, in the order of the bullets, then the rest highest rank first.

expected_load_notice.description: Null unless the Expected-load context section gives a notice. Then that notice, extended only by what the items show; at most 2 lines of at most 120 characters; dates and numbers only as given or as the items' evidence; no URLs. The gate checks it like the headline.

replace_with.description: Full new memory text within the cap, or null for no change; code stores the diff.

body.description: Pattern-level; identifiers are masked and flagged by code (FR-033).

title: agent-watchdog brief draft (roll-up output)
description: Structured output of the roll-up call. Bullets reference items by id; the gate checks every number against computed data and every structural limit before publication.
